title: Dynam3D: Dynamic Layered 3D Tokens Empower VLM for Vision-and-Language Navi

predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The condition for removing a feature point is '0 < z_c < min(d_{u,v}+δ, Δ)'. This would remove points that are in front of the observed surface (including points on the surface that satisfy z_c ≈ d_{u,v}), effectively erasing all visible points each frame. The intended culling of occluded points requires z_c > min(d_{u,v}+δ, Δ). The inequality direction is incorrect and would break the map maintenance.

predicted_errors.error_location: Section 4.3, sentence: 'Details on experimental controls and safety measures are provided in the supplementary materials.'
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The supplementary materials (Appendix A.1) contain no details on experimental controls or safety measures for the real-world dynamic navigation experiments. The claim references non-existent content.

Reported average LLM time per step is 315 ms during training and 540 ms during inference. Training normally includes both forward and backward passes and should not be faster than inference. This discrepancy suggests a measurement or reporting error.

The real-world experiments involve a moving object/target (manually moved while robot approaches) which involves human-robot interaction and potential safety risks. The paper itself notes that ethical approval, participant consent, and safety protocols are not discussed, and the supplementary materials do not supply them. This constitutes a missing ethics statement and risk assessment.
